_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Druid tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the druid kit carries forms later Classic-era druids never got (Moonkin Form, Tree of Life, Travel/Aquatic/Dire Bear) and Forever additions in the base kit: Prowl (cat-38 stealth, shares the category with rogue Stealth), Cower, Primal Bite, Shifting Power, Swiftmend, Wild Rejuvenation, Wild Growth, Astral Power, Nature's Grasp, Savage Roar, Gift of the Wild, Force of Nature. There is NO Tiger's Fury, no Innervate-cost change, and Mangle is kept OUT on purpose: its only row in this build (409828) is filed under Family 3 (the Mage family code -- a data quirk, verified 2026-11-01), and the generator never takes a foreign-family row, not even via the uncoded fallback. Rebirth carries a 30-min shared category cooldown (category 26). Some names (Enrage, Growl, Thorns, Lacerate, Cure Poison) collide across families; the generator picks the highest-rank row globally, which is fine for name-keyed cast tracking. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added -- cooldowns += Skull Bash (the bear stun), Berserk (the druid Berserker CD), Starfall (90 s category), Dash (the family-less Q6 mobility row, 30 s category); buffs += Lifebloom, Pounce + Pounce Bleed (the cat opener pair), Thrash (the family-less Q6 row, name-only in this build). The reference's proc/passive names for this class -- see _deferred_H7 -- ride with H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md) after the launch-day probes. Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1/§7.7 + Blizzard dev notes post 9): Berserk PRUNED from [cooldowns] (post 9: 'Berserk talent removed (Primal Bite replaces)'; the client capture still ships the 417141 180 s row -- upstream-data §5 row 16, hotfix-watch); [buffs] += Ferocious Bite (the post-9 new Rank 1 at level 24 -- the pick rides the top rank of the ladder) and Bloom (the new Rejuvenation/Regrowth-expiry heal, 1328621, the store's value row carries a 0 ms window: announce layer, not a bar); the Primal Bite pick moves off the value-less Rank 4 (1238073) to the store's ranked top Rank 3 (1238070) by the new rank law. Wave I-3 H7 (2026-11-03, upstream-data §3.1/§7.3, fx-worker I3e): Clearcasting MOVED OUT of _deferred_H7 into [buffs] -- the wowsims MIT names.json keys druid clearcasting at 16870 and the base row (15000) and the 70707 value row (16870 durationMs 15000, procFlag 87376) agree on a 15 s proc window (upstream-data §3.1 row 1). The three kept _deferred_H7 names have no names.json key (§3.1 Unresolvable): Living Seed (base 414680, a 15 s MoP proc), Nature's Grace (16886, 3 s) and Savage Defense (410144, 10 s, uncoded family) ride Classic-era base rows whose 2026-kit keying is a launch-day probe, not MIT name-verified data. In combat a proc window is a sealed aura read: Forte_Timer/Core/Reconcile.lua Gates() (:78-92) runs ZERO aura reads in combat, so the proc row is drawn by the out-of-combat sweep (:300-315) and a sealed read never fabricates a row.

Berserking.reason: all four 70790 rows (20554/23505/24378/1286304) are value-less name shells (no Cooldowns row), so the bare-row tiebreak rides the arbitrary max-id shell; 20554 is the id measured 180 s on the live client (tools/overrides_devnotes_2026-11-03.json, owner session 2026-11-06; review-10 M2/m4). The druid carries Berserking (Troll) but NOT Rapid Regeneration (a Dwarf racial the druid roster cannot roll)
